name: cpu-v1
description: CPU RMA validation. Full-load kill test first, then isolates integer ALU, floating-point, cache, and VRM transient paths. GPU probe-only throughout.

phases.name: baseline
phases.notes: 15s idle baseline. Capture reference temps, clocks, voltages for drift rules.

phases.name: full-load
phases.notes: 5 min all-core max stress. Kill test — near-dead CPU, VRM failure, thermal runaway all crash here. Don't waste 30 min to find out.

phases.name: integer-alu
phases.notes: 10 min integer matrix multiply. Exercises integer ALU pipelines, register file, integer scheduler.

phases.name: floating-point
phases.notes: 10 min FFT. Exercises FP pipelines, SIMD/AVX units. Higher power draw on Zen than integer.

phases.name: cache-stress
phases.notes: 10 min cache thrash. --cpu keeps ALUs busy while --cache workers hammer L1/L2/L3. Exercises coherency, MOESI, inter-CCD. RAM idle so cache misses don't alias as memory faults.

phases.name: ramp
phases.notes: 10 min ramp 20-40-60-80-100%. VRM transient response — marginal power delivery shows up during load transitions, not steady state.

phases.name: cooldown
phases.notes: 5 min cooldown. Post-load errors, clock recovery, thermal hysteresis.
